prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Personalize Your Desktop Companion"]
1: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Scroll to discover how your desktop pet lives, plays, and assists on your screen."]
2: ["Sign In to Sync & Restore Your Pet", "Log in to secure your companion data, access your pet across devices, and restore previous pets.", "Cloud Pet Sync Active"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home"]
4: ["Your Pet Has Arrived on Your Desktop!", "Look at your desktop screen to find your pet. Use the system tray icon anytime to interact, minimize, or adjust settings.", "Active on Desktop"]
5: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your companion adoption is complete and saved to your account."]
6: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to join you!"]
7: ["Choose Your Path: Create Custom or Adopt Instant Companion", "Generate a unique pet from your photos or select from our curated starter companions immediately."]
8: ["100% Cloud Saved Companion Data"]
9: ["Tip: Click the System Tray icon to summon or customize your pet anytime!"]
